title: 菊花賞の後に・本走にして助走

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite suffering another loss, Tamamo Cross doesn't look entirely defeated as she looks out onto the Kyoto track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The experience Tamamo Cross has picked up here will lend itself well to the spring Tenno Sho, another long-distance senior G1 race held in Kyoto—and one that her father holds in high regard.
